1#_: Beriah. 3#_: Who changed form of bread. See Mahari"t part 2 siman 18 — change helps only at home, not much bread to sell in market — guests won't recognize — even with announcement forbidden lest forget; Chokhmat Adam — change only at baking time no prohibition yet — change after forbidden ineffective; dividing to many people each small amount forbidden since already nevelah — Peri Megadim not like grandfather; Mahari"t — forbidding without change only where concern eating with cheese together; where no concern like sweets not eaten with cheese — permitted with fat, no decree lest afterward eat cheese — judge what they forbade — see there further reasons.
